content:
deploy-bot: Hotfix image pushed: registry.redwood/inference/ingress-proxy:hotfix-2026-03-23-cf4a
deploy-bot: Initiating guarded canary in dedicated-eu-central-1: 2% -> 10% step, monitor 8m. UI: https://console.redwood/releases/cf4a

lee: getting alerts for request stalls from a Major tenant ~10m ago. Thanks for the patch.

priya: quick question: does this change any connection limits or backpressure behavior?

infra-jen: it tightens per-worker conn_limit 600->350 and adds jitter to reconnect, intended to avoid head-of-line blocking. Load tests looked fine.

ops-lead: rollback gates: abort if errors >2% sustained 3m OR p95 >1.5s for 5m OR instance_restarts >=2 in 10m. Also manual rollback if dedicated tenant reports new 5xx spikes.

release-manager: approvals required: ops-lead + infra-jen + oncall. I will post customer-facing note after promotion.

oncall-maya: monitoring oncall, +1. Can execute rollback if needed.

infra-jen: +1 from infra after code review. No infra migration needed.

ops-lead: +1. Because Major tenant impacted, keep manual-promote steps.

priya: ok kicking canary. Command: ```/deploy canary --svc ingress-proxy --image registry.redwood/inference/ingress-proxy:hotfix-2026-03-23-cf4a --canary 2% --step 10% --monitor 8m```

deploy-bot: Canary started -> 2% then stepping to 10%. Posting metric snapshots to channel.

(deploy-bot update) 3287654340: canary snapshot: errors 1.2%, p95 940ms, qps 310, restarts 0

lee: logs show reduced "connection accept" timeouts. Positive signal.

priya: ops, recommend ramp to 50% with 10m soak then promote to 100% if steady.

ops-lead: agree. Ramp plan OK, but keep rollback playbook open for 45m post-promote.

infra-jen: running ramp: ```/deploy promote --svc ingress-proxy --to 50% --wait 10m```

deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% started. ETA ~3m.

(deploy-bot update) 3287654385: promotion complete. final metrics: errors 0.9%, p95 800ms, restarts 0. All good.

release-manager: I've posted the release note and notified CS and Dedicated account execs. Draft: "Ingress proxy hotfix: connection cap tuning to reduce stalled requests for dedicated tenants. Rolling now."

ops-lead: Nice work. Keep an eye on the Major tenant for next 2 hours; if anything odd, oncall to trigger rollback and infra to revert image.

lee: will follow up in the incident tracker if we see recurrence. Thanks team! :thumbsup:
